use numbers

Good = Sums less K
Codes = Codes Good
Sums = Sums Good
Count = Codes len
Index = array shape Bound fill 0
Index Codes = 0 till Count copy
Limit = N * (K - 1) // (D + 1)
Width = Limit + 1
Places = 0 till Width copy
Counts = 1 till K copy
Facts = Counts scan *
Facts = concat (array 1) Facts
Weights = 1.0 / Facts

rem Expand only legal incoming edges.
EdgeCounts = K - Sums
Ends = EdgeCounts scan +
Begins = Ends - EdgeCounts
Edges = EdgeCounts sum
Positions = 0 till Edges copy
Owners = Ends upperindex Positions
Oldest = Positions - Begins Owners
Previous = Oldest * K ** (D - 1)
Previous += Codes Owners // K
Sources = Index Previous
Last = Codes Owners mod K
Added = Last reshape Edges 1
Pops = Places reshape 1 Width
Offsets = Pops - Added
Parents = Sources reshape Edges 1
Addresses = Parents * Width + Offsets
Size = Edges * Width
Cells = Addresses reshape Size
Mask = Offsets less 0 reshape Size
Cells Mask = Count * Width
Links = Cells reshape Edges Width
Rows = Owners reshape Edges 1
Groups = Rows * Width + Pops copy
Factors = Weights (Codes mod K)
Factors = concat Factors (array 0.0)
Size = (Count + 1) * Width
RateSlots = 0 till Size copy
RateRows = RateSlots // Width
Rates = Factors RateRows
States = 0 till Count copy
Marks = Codes mod K
Chosen = Marks greater 0
Chosen = Chosen or (States equal 0)
Starts = States Chosen

fun Start paths
  Values = array shape Size fill 0.0

  for # in 1 to N

arg N integer = 365

arg D integer = 7

Facts = Counts scan *
Facts = concat (array 1) Facts

rem A(n) weights day counts by 1/c!;
rem expectation sums A(n) n! / N^n.
rem Sparse entries of the transfer.

Ends = EdgeCounts scan +
Begins = Ends - EdgeCounts
Edges = EdgeCounts sum

Owners = Ends upperindex Positions

Sources = Index Previous
Added = Codes Owners mod K

Range = 0 till Order copy
Size = Order * Order
Jacobi = array shape Size fill 0.0
Diagonal = Range * Order + Range
Jacobi Diagonal = 2.0 * Range + 1.0

Lower = Side * Order + Side - 1
Jacobi Upper = Side * 1.0

Table = Jacobi reshape Order Order
Spectrum = Table eigh
Nodes = Spectrum 0

Vectors = Spectrum 1

Weights = First * First

fun X trace
  Terms = X ** Added / Divisors
  Size = Count * Count
  Matrix = array shape Size fill 0.0
  Matrix Slots = Terms
  Table = Matrix reshape Count Count
  Power = Table matpow N
  Diagonal = Power diag
  return Diagonal sum
end
Samples = Nodes / N
Values = Samples trace rank 0
Mass = Values * Weights
Answer = Mass sum
Answer = Answer round 8

rem Birthday Problem Revisited
rem https://projecteuler.net/problem=584

use numbers
use sequences
use io
use cli

arg N integer = 365
arg K integer = 4
arg D integer = 7

rem E = sum over n of P(no K people
rem within D days of each other) = sum
rem of A(n) n! / N^n, A(n) the weight
rem sum over day counts c_1 .. c_N with
rem every D + 1 cyclic days holding at
rem most K - 1 people, of prod 1 / c_i!.
rem A(n) is the x^n coefficient of the
rem trace of the N-th power of a
rem transfer matrix on the counts of
rem the last D days (sum <= K - 1), each
rem new day c weighing x^c / c!.
Bs = K ** D
Ix = array shape Bs fill 0 - 1
Sn = 0
Ds = array shape 0 fill 0
for Cd in 0 till Bs
  Sm = 0
  Cu = Cd
  for # in 1 to D
    Sm += (Cu mod K)
    Cu = Cu // K
  end
  if Sm at most K - 1
    Ix Cd = Sn
    Ds = concat Ds (array Cd)
    Sn += 1
  end
end
Mc = K - 1
Nx = array shape Sn K fill 0 - 1
Su = array shape Sn fill 0
Sh = K ** (D - 1)
for S in 0 till Sn
  Cd = Ds S
  Sm = 0
  Cu = Cd
  for # in 1 to D
    Sm += (Cu mod K)
    Cu = Cu // K
  end
  Su S = Sm
  for C in 0 to Mc - Sm
    Nc = (Cd mod Sh) * K + C
    Nx S C = Ix Nc
  end
end
Pm = N * Mc // (D + 1)
If = array shape K fill 1.0
for C in 1 till K
  If C = (If (C - 1)) / C
end
Ac = array shape (Pm + 1) fill 0.0
for S0 in 0 till Sn
  Mark = (Ds S0) mod K
  if Mark equal 0
    continue
  end
  Dp = array shape Sn (Pm + 1) fill 0.0
  Dp S0 0 = 1.0
  for Dy in 1 to N
    Nw = Dp * 0.0
    for S in 0 till Sn
      for C in 0 to Mc - (Su S)
        T = Nx S C
        W = If C
        for P in 0 to Pm - C
          Nw T (P + C) += W * (Dp S P)
        end
      end
    end
    Dp = Nw
  end
  for P in 0 to Pm
    Ac P += Mark * (Dp S0 P)
  end
end
Lf = array shape (Pm + 1) fill 0.0
for P in 1 to Pm
  Lg = P * 1.0 log
  Lf P = (Lf (P - 1)) + Lg
end
Ln = N * 1.0 log
Answer = 1.0
for P in 1 to Pm
  Ex = (Lf P) - P * Ln
  Answer += (Ac P) * (Ex exp) * N / P
end
Answer = Answer round 8
Answer print
